tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Categories with the number of published listings in each.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search published listings by category slug, city and/or a name fragment. Paginate with offset.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One published listing by id or slug, including its state license records (Florida DBPR so far).

tools.name: prefill_from_website
tools.description: Opens the business website and returns the details it shows (name, phone, email, city, state, description) plus a free website check report. Use the fields to prepare submit_listing; ask the owner for anything missing.

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.description: Submit a business. The only thing you need is its website: name, city, state, phone and description are read from the site when you leave them out. Do not ask the owner questions unless this tool returns missing_field. Category is optional (unknown values are kept as the industry). Send the business

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.description: Status of a submission: checking, published, yellow (waiting for review), red (held for the owner of the directory), or rejected, with reason codes and the result of each automatic check.

tools.name: request_owner_confirmation
tools.description: Starts owner confirmation for a published listing. Returns confirm_url and user_code to show to the business owner (they confirm with Google or a company email), plus site_verification if you can edit the business website. Once confirmed, the API key you used here may edit the listing with update_li

tools.name: get_claim_status
tools.description: Status of an owner confirmation: pending, confirmed or expired.

tools.name: verify_site
tools.description: After publishing the site_verification file or meta tag on the business website, call this to confirm.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Fill in or edit the listing: name, description, services, service_area (other cities served), hours, social, phone, website, industry_label. A complete listing can appear in Google, is shown higher in its city and appears in the cities it serves. Needs an API key the confirmed owner approved.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prefill_from_website, submit_listing, get_submission_status · Private data: get_listing, request_owner_confirmation, verify_site, update_listing · Public sink: prefill_from_website, submit_listing, request_owner_confirmation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prefill_from_website, submit_listing, get_submission_status · Private data: get_listing, request_owner_confirmation, verify_site, update_listing · Public sink: prefill_from_website, submit_listing, request_owner_confirmation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
